title: Visualizing Calling Card Data on the WashU Epigenome Browser
author: Arnav Moudgil
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bca8ishw

steps.title: Compress and Index Data Files
steps.instruction: Prepare text-based files (CCF, bedgraph, or BED) for hosting on an external server using htslib.

substeps.instruction: Compress the file using bgzip (e.g., 'bgzip HCT-116_PBase.ccf' to create 'HCT-116_PBase.ccf.gz').
Index the compressed file using tabix (e.g., 'tabix -p bed HCT-116_PBase.ccf.gz' to create 'HCT-116_PBase.ccf.gz.tbi').
Copy both the compressed file (.gz) and the index file (.tbi) to a publicly-accessible webserver.

steps.title: Create a JSON Configuration File
steps.instruction: Create a plain text JSON file (e.g., HCT-116_PBase.json) using a text editor to describe the tracks and their properties.

substeps.instruction: Define each track within square brackets [...] using curly braces {...} and commas to separate tracks.
For calling card tracks, specify 'type':'callingcard', the 'url' of the compressed file, a 'name', and 'showOnHubLoad':'true'.

Optional: Customize calling card tracks using the 'options' object: 'color' (default blue), 'height' (default 40 pixels), 'logScale' ('log10' for logarithmic scale), 'markerSize' (default 3 pixels), 'opacity' (integer 0-100 in square brackets, default [100]), 'show' ('all' or 'sample'), and 'sampleSize' (default 1000).
Optional: Add bedgraph and BED files to the JSON using 'type':'bedgraph' or 'type':'bed' with their respective URLs and names.

steps.title: Upload Data via Custom Data Hub
steps.instruction: Load the JSON configuration file into the WashU Epigenome Browser to visualize hosted data.

substeps.instruction: Go to the browser homepage and select the appropriate genome.
Click the blue 'Tracks' button and select 'Custom tracks'.
Select the 'Add Custom Data Hub' tab.
Click 'Choose datahub file', select the JSON file from your system, and upload it.
Close the custom track pane by clicking the red X in the upper right corner.

steps.title: Alternative: Direct Text File Upload
steps.instruction: Upload uncompressed text-based data files (CCF, bedgraph, or BED) directly to the browser.

substeps.instruction: Click the blue 'Tracks' button and select 'Text track'.
Select the appropriate track type (e.g., 'callingcard') from the dropdown menu.
Click 'Choose Files' and select one or more uncompressed files to upload.
Close the pane by clicking the red X in the top right corner once tracks have loaded.

steps.title: Customize and Inspect Tracks
steps.instruction: Interact with the loaded data and adjust visual preferences.

substeps.instruction: Right-click on a track to open the preference pane for dynamic customization.
Hover the mouse cursor over data points in the calling card track to view the rollover box containing approximate location, read count, strand, and barcode.
